text: The St. Clair Gardens Business Improvement Area and local residents have requested proactive measures be taken by the City's enforcement agencies, in order to avert problem activities at 1708 and 1776 St. Clair Avenue West, and to establish a safer environment for the community. The local Councillor has brought this matter forward in order to address various community safety issues which have had an impact on the quality of life for the local residents.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Requested the Acting District Manager, Etobicoke York District, Municipal Licensing and Standards, and the Manager, By-law Enforcement, West District, Municipal Licensing and Standards, to consult with officials from the Toronto Police Services' 11 and 12 Divisions and the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario, and report to the Etobicoke York Community Council meeting of April 4, 2018 on: a. Charges and convictions (including pending) pertaining to 1708 and 1776 St. Clair Avenue West. b. How the local Business Improvement Area and residential community can assist Municipal Licensing and Standards, the Toronto Police Services' 11 and 12 Divisions, and/or the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario, to obtain convictions or revocation of LCBO license, such as with community impact statements. 2.
